description: Net formal charge inside the base pocket versus at the mouth, ATP-specific Blastocystis 6NO0 against GTP-specific pig 2FP4, after superposition on the purine ring
code:
import os, requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def fetch(pid):
    p=f"pdb/{pid}.pdb"
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        r=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=120); r.raise_for_status(); open(p,"w").write(r.text)
    return p
def parse(pid):
    rows=[]
    for line in open(fetch(pid)):
        if line.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            if line[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
            el=(line[76:78].strip() or line[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
            if el=="H": continue
            rows.append((line[:6].strip(),line[12:16].strip(),line[17:20].strip(),line[21],
                         int(line[22:26]),float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54]),el))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns="rec name resn chain resi x y z el".split())
X=lambda d: d[["x","y","z"]].to_numpy(float)
RING=["N9","C8","N7","C5","C4","N3","C2","N1","C6"]
TIP={"LYS":("NZ",+1),"ARG":("CZ",+1),"GLU":("CD",-1),"ASP":("CG",-1)}
def kabsch(Q,P):
    cq,cp=Q.mean(0),P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((Q-cq).T@(P-cp))
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T; return R, cp-R@cq

b=parse("6NO0"); adp=b[b.resn=="ADP"]; adp=adp[adp.chain==adp.chain.iloc[0]]
bb=b[(b.rec=="ATOM")&(b.chain==adp.chain.iloc[0])].reset_index(drop=True)
p=parse("2FP4"); gtp=p[(p.resn=="GTP")&(p.chain=="B")]
pb=p[(p.chain=="B")&(p.rec=="ATOM")].reset_index(drop=True)
A=np.array([X(adp[adp.name==n])[0] for n in RING]); G=np.array([X(gtp[gtp.name==n])[0] for n in RING])
R,t=kabsch(G,A); cen=A.mean(0)

def charges(prot, Xp):
    out=[]
    for (ri,rn),g in prot.groupby(["resi","resn"]):
        if rn in TIP:
            nm,q=TIP[rn]; s=g.index[g.name==nm]
            if len(s): out.append((f"{rn}{ri}", q, Xp[s[0]]))
    return out
cWT=charges(bb, X(bb)); cPig=charges(pb, (X(pb)@R.T)+t)

rows=[]
for tag,c in [("Blastocystis 6NO0 (ATP specific)",cWT),("Pig 2FP4 beta (GTP specific)",cPig)]:
    for cut in (8,10,12,15):
        inside=[(n,q,np.linalg.norm(x-cen)) for n,q,x in c if np.linalg.norm(x-cen)<=cut]
        rows.append(dict(structure=tag, radius_A=cut, n_charges=len(inside),
                         net_charge=sum(q for _,q,_ in inside),
                         residues=", ".join(f"{n}{'+' if q>0 else '-'}@{d:.1f}" for n,q,d in sorted(inside,key=lambda z:z[2]))))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",200)
print(df[["structure","radius_A","n_charges","net_charge"]].to_string(index=False))
print()
for r in df[df.radius_A==12].itertuples():
    print(f"{r.structure}, within 12 A of the base centroid: net {r.net_charge:+d}")
    print("   ",r.residues,"\n")
df.to_csv("pocket_charge_comparison.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4.2))
for tag,col in [("Blastocystis 6NO0 (ATP specific)","#3b6ea5"),("Pig 2FP4 beta (GTP specific)","#a53b3b")]:
    s=df[df.structure==tag]
    ax.plot(s.radius_A, s.net_charge, "o-", color=col, label=tag)
ax.axhline(0,c="grey",lw=1,ls="--")
ax.set_xlabel("radius around the purine base centroid (A)"); ax.set_ylabel("net formal side-chain charge")
ax.set_title("Charge around the base: the GTP-specific enzyme is the more negative one", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
